options swap_delay=12 iteration=20 ignore_burst_energy=true;

raiden char lvl=90/90 cons=0 talent=9,9,9;
raiden add weapon="thecatch" refine=5 lvl=90/90;
raiden add set="emblemofseveredfate" count=4;
raiden add stats er=0.5;

fischl char lvl=90/90 cons=0 talent=9,9,9;
fischl add weapon="slingshot" refine=5 lvl=90/90;
fischl add set="emblemofseveredfate" count=4;

xingqiu char lvl=90/90 cons=0 talent=9,9,9;
xingqiu add weapon="harbingerofdawn" refine=5 lvl=90/90;
xingqiu add set="emblemofseveredfate" count=4;

bennett char lvl=90/90 cons=0 talent=9,9,9;
bennett add weapon="harbingerofdawn" refine=5 lvl=90/90;
bennett add set="emblemofseveredfate" count=4;

target lvl=100 resist=0.1 radius=2 pos=0,2.4 hp=999999999;

active xingqiu;
for let i = 0; i < 4; i = i + 1 {
  xingqiu skill, burst;
  fischl skill;
  bennett skill;
  raiden skill, burst;
  raiden attack:15;
  wait(240);
}
